title: Flamel Public Content
description: Read-only MCP server for Flamel.ai's public content: company overview, blog, case studies, FAQs.
summary: Read-only MCP server for Flamel.ai's public content: company overview, blog, case studies, FAQs.
offersHint: Read-only MCP server for Flamel.ai's public content: company overview, blog, case studies, FAQs. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://www.flamel.ai/mcp

toolsPreview.name: get_company_overview
toolsPreview.description: Get a structured overview of Flamel: what the product does, who it is for, the solution areas, key links, and how to contact sales or start a trial. Start here if you know nothing about Flamel.

toolsPreview.name: search_flamel_content
toolsPreview.description: Full-text search across Flamel's published blog posts, case studies, and FAQ entries. Use this first when you do not already know which page answers the question.

toolsPreview.name: list_blog_posts
toolsPreview.description: List published Flamel blog posts, newest first. Optionally filter by category. Returns titles, URLs, summaries, and publish dates, not full bodies.

toolsPreview.name: get_blog_post
toolsPreview.description: Fetch the full body of one published Flamel blog post as Markdown, by slug.

toolsPreview.name: list_blog_categories
toolsPreview.description: List the blog categories available for filtering `list_blog_posts`.

toolsPreview.name: list_case_studies
toolsPreview.description: List published Flamel customer case studies with their headline results.

toolsPreview.name: get_case_study
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one Flamel case study by slug: the challenge, the solution, the results, and customer quotes.

toolsPreview.name: list_faqs
toolsPreview.description: List published Flamel FAQ entries: platform capabilities, pricing model, onboarding, integrations, and security. Good for direct factual questions about the product.

toolsPreview.name: list_testimonials
toolsPreview.description: List published customer testimonials about Flamel, with the author name, title, and company.
